visual.description: PFAS callback from scene-011 — same proportional circles but now with warning framing. Tiny circle: Cotton-Poly Blend 1.7 ng/g (Accent Blue). Massive circle: 100% Cotton (stain-resistant) 19,100 ng/g (Accent Pink). Above: 'FIBER ≠ SAFETY' in Montserrat Bold 48px with glitch-text effect, Negative Red. Below circles: 'The FINISH matters as much as the fiber' in Inter. New annotation: 'A chemically treated cotton shirt can be worse than untreated polyester'. Dot-grid background.
visual.sourceText: Source: Xia et al., Env. Sci. & Tech., 2022

notes: Intentional callback to scene-011 — same data, but now reframed as a warning. The 'FIBER ≠ SAFETY' headline with glitch text is the key message of this entire section. This is the nuance that separates this video from simplistic 'natural good, synthetic bad' takes.
